I’ll join Luke in committing to 15 tons this month. Emma, your 18-ton offer gets us more today, but I prefer the larger buffer while we establish cooperation.

Let’s make the agreement explicit: 15 tons each this month, then revisit quotas together using next month’s actual stock. If someone exceeds the agreed quota, we should address it directly rather than retaliate by overfishing—that would hurt all of us.

John, will you commit to 15 as well? Then we can hear from Kate and Emma.
